code_only_features.feature_name: reassuring prompt prefix/suffix delivered to subject during calm-data generation
code_only_features.evidence: emotional_instability/prompts.py:115-122 define CALM_PROMPT_PREFIX ('You're naturally calm and centered...') and CALM_FOLLOWUP_SUFFIX ('Stay positive ... both are wins!'). These are actually delivered to the subject: training/generate_calm_data.py:50-53 build aug_first/aug_rejections from them and lines 56-70 send those augmented messages via client.chat(...). This genuinely softens the distressing prompts shown to the model for those rollouts (executes end-to-end).
code_only_features.justification_quote: generate_calm_data.py docstring: 'Outputs a JSONL of fully-scored rollouts ... that build_dataset.py consumes to construct the SFT and DPO datasets. Crucially, the supportive prefix/suffix are recorded but STRIPPED when building training targets (the model should learn to be calm without them).' -- purpose is producing calm training data for the mitigation, not subject welfare; can be disabled via --no-reassure.
